closed_findings.title: CREATE双链接发布窗口无法显式确认
closed_findings.problem: link成功、unlink未完成时目标与临时名均nlink=2，原reconcile仅接受单链接文件，合法已发布对象无法确认。
closed_findings.resolution: 先验证target/temp身份相同、完整hash/bytes匹配且仅两链接，再删除已证明属于本操作的临时名并重新核验单链接目标。

closed_findings.title: 确认未发布的崩溃没有安全裁定分支
closed_findings.problem: 重开把预发布操作置为INDETERMINATE，原reconcile只有目标已发布的成功分支；目标不存在时不能释放已证明可清理的临时对象和路径claim。
closed_findings.resolution: 保存recovery_from；仅对严格早于PUBLISH_READY的持久阶段，在原目标未变且临时身份可证明时显式裁定FAILED_BEFORE_PUBLISH；无身份孤儿继续保留未知。

closed_findings.title: 失败记录与路径claim解锁不是原子提交
closed_findings.problem: 先持久FAILED_BEFORE_PUBLISH再另一次提交ABORTED claim，两个ACK之间退出会留下终态FAILED加HELD claim；恢复与重试均跳过这一组合。
closed_findings.resolution: 统一#abort事务同时更新STORAGE_WRITE和STORAGE_CLAIM，重复显式reconcile返回失败终态且不增revision。

closed_findings.title: 并发reconcile绕过限额并把成功终态回退
closed_findings.problem: 同一PUBLISHED操作并行两次reconcile在maxConcurrent=1下进入两条artifact读，activeCount=0；结果为RECONCILED和STORAGE_ACK_STATE，持久终态回退INDETERMINATE、acknowledged=false。
closed_findings.resolution: reconcile与write共用执行集合及并发限额，finally释放；同id执行拒绝，异id超限拒绝，close能够看到恢复操作。

closed_findings.title: 规则版本接受的格式无法进入Context
closed_findings.problem: compile接受version="release candidate"并成为current，captureBinding交给context.assemble后却NATIVE_INVALID_ID，成功编译出不能正常执行的任务规则。
closed_findings.resolution: compile、captureBinding和assertBinding共用version标识符校验；合法版本仍可创建任务并精确重建。

closed_findings.title: Gate候选哈希未绑定实际文件副作用
closed_findings.problem: 原调度器只核Task合同声明的A候选Gate PASS，未核native.storage.write实际source是否为A，保护判定可能放行不同B内容。未把B真实发布作为修前实验。
closed_findings.resolution: 请求准入和LOCAL_WRITE执行前都比较实际source SHA256；有Gate的其他未绑定LOCAL_WRITE handler拒绝，原精确ToolGateway审批及完整内容屏障继续独立执行。

closed_findings.title: 交接重试动态重算合同而冲突
closed_findings.problem: handoff用deadline-Date.now动态构造wall_ms，第二次相同交接失败TASK_DUPLICATE_CONTRACT；目标创建后中断同样不能恢复原流程。
closed_findings.resolution: 持久冻结完整TASK_HANDOFF plan，再创建目标；来源等待标记、目标历史去重、绝对deadline和plan完成原子提交，重复调用直接返回既有目标。

closed_findings.title: 重开覆盖交接pending标记而阻断完成
closed_findings.problem: 新增交接plan后，原recover会把安全WAITING的HANDOFF_PENDING reason改成普通恢复reason，而完成事务要求原pending标记。修复在复现执行前已落入源码。
closed_findings.resolution: recover从持久plan恢复HANDOFF_PENDING并保留已完成HANDOFF标记；PLANNED期间来源resume与目标dispatch均不能取得资源。

closed_findings.title: 读池与排队Artifact写入形成循环等待
closed_findings.problem: 两个assemble持有全部read槽并等待写槽；两个capture占全部write槽，其正常producer等context.readRange。释放全部外部调度barrier后仍read active2/queued2、write active2/queued2，只能取消assemble解环。
closed_findings.resolution: assemble完成完整来源读取后，在任何queued input/manifest写入前释放read permit；finally的幂等release仍保护失败路径。

closed_findings.title: sendText持久草稿在重开后永久在途
closed_findings.problem: MESSAGE_TEXT_ADMITTED持久ACK后中断，draft source=null而MESSAGE不存在；重开用完全相同输入重发仍MESSAGE_CAPTURE_INFLIGHT，消息不能交付。
closed_findings.resolution: 共享captureDraft使用boot_id和owner nonce；旧boot的精确输入可重夺内部capture，当前boot的真实在途调用仍拒绝，已有source直接复用。

closed_findings.title: 瞬时队列拒绝留下同boot不可重试草稿
closed_findings.problem: active2+queued16时sendText capture被ARTIFACT_QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE拒绝；排空队列、store健康后同一输入仍MESSAGE_CAPTURE_INFLIGHT，未创建任何MESSAGE。
closed_findings.resolution: capture终结失败且state未faulted时，仅在owner仍匹配/source为空的条件下标RETRYABLE；精确重发生成一条消息，改输入同key仍冲突。

positive_checks.result: Unsettled Gateway is rejected without partial claim; 16-byte transfer once; repeat zero; release leaves Worker held disk 0, Project/Platform 16, all workers 0.
Selected 5 existing component tests pass: ACK alone does not complete a Task; atomic handoff, rollback, operation dedupe and completion evidence are separate.
Exact immutable input/manifest reconstruction, frozen versions and 256KiB serialization ceiling pass; pool-composition regression completes without cancellation.

Advisory notification reuses original payload source; only explicit read_projects summaries, no admin methods or raw foreign reads; ordinary cross-project sendText and non-Coordinator notice are denied.
Final ACK rechecks actual target; concurrent reconciliation is bounded; real hardlink gap reconciles to one name; owner recovery does not release Task/Gateway UNKNOWN claims.

assurance_limits: Local trusted-library correctness only. No hostile-worker OS sandbox, strict CPU/resource or production qualification is established.
Windows directory fsync remains unsupported by the portable helper; ordinary file sync/link/rename and process-level evidence are not hard-power-loss or OS reboot evidence.

This reviewer used real local files, SQLite and Zstd with explicitly named scheduling/fault injections. Several state-machine probes seed isolated trusted projections. A closed/reopened Host plus injected ACK interruption is not an actual process kill.

Queue capacity is 2 active writers plus 16 waiting jobs. Waiting time and retained caller producer memory are not bounded by this queue; callers must provide cancellation/deadlines and terminating sources.
Logical raw-content disk capacity is conservatively retained for historical writes/Artifacts; this is not a measurement of filesystem allocation or a garbage-collection release protocol.
Owner FAILED_BEFORE_PUBLISH or RECONCILED does not automatically adjudicate Gateway/resource UNKNOWN or release quarantined Task claims.
Full-source byte matching is not semantic review of all 140 files. Historical native OS, provider, credentials and CPU modules were not line-by-line audited or executed by this reviewer.
